milestones.name: Hello LLM
milestones.goal: Talk to an LLM with streaming output

features.name: Project Scaffold
features.description: go mod init, directory structure per concentric-ring model, minimal main.go, verify go build passes

features.name: Message Types
features.description: Define provider-agnostic Message, Role, ToolCall, ToolResult, Response types in pkg/llm/

features.name: LLM Interface
features.description: Define LLM interface with Chat() and ChatStream() returning iter.Seq2[Chunk, error]. Define Option pattern.

features.name: OpenAI-Compatible Provider
features.description: Implement OpenAI-compatible provider: HTTP client, SSE stream parsing, message format conversion. Works with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama.

features.name: Anthropic Provider
features.description: Implement Anthropic Claude provider: Messages API, streaming, tool_use block conversion.

features.name: CLI Chat Demo
features.description: Simple CLI that reads user input, sends to LLM, prints streaming response. First runnable demo.

milestones.name: Tool Calling
milestones.goal: Agent can define and execute typed tools

features.name: Tool Interface
features.description: Define Tool interface: Name(), Description(), Schema(), Execute(). Define ToolSet interface for dynamic tool collections.

features.name: JSON Schema Generation
features.description: Implement NewTool[Args] generic constructor that generates JSON Schema from Go struct tags via reflection.

features.name: Tool Registry
features.description: Tool registry: register/lookup by name, list all schemas for LLM request, concurrent-safe.

features.name: Built-in Tools: Calculator + Clock
features.description: Two trivial tools to validate the tool system end-to-end: calculator (add/multiply) and current time.

features.name: Tool Calling Integration
features.description: Wire tool schemas into LLM request, parse tool_calls from response, execute and return results. Single-step only (no loop yet).

milestones.name: ReAct Agent
milestones.ai_skills: ReAct pattern, step limit, parallel tool execution

features.name: Event Types
features.description: Define Event sum type: ThinkEvent, ToolCallEvent, ToolResultEvent, FinalResponseEvent, ErrorEvent.

features.name: ReAct Loop
features.description: Core ~200-line ReAct loop: while(tool_calls) { call LLM → execute tools → append results }. max_steps guard. Returns iter.Seq2[Event, error].

features.name: Parallel Tool Execution
features.description: When LLM returns multiple tool_calls, execute them concurrently via goroutine + errgroup. Timeout per tool.

features.name: Agent Interface
features.description: Define Agent interface with Run(ctx, task) iter.Seq2[Event, error]. Implement SimpleAgent wrapping ReAct loop.

features.name: Built-in Tools: File + Shell
features.description: File read/write/list and shell exec tools with basic sandboxing (allowed dirs, command allowlist).

milestones.name: Context Engineering
milestones.goal: Three-tier context compaction + stage-aware context loading
milestones.ai_skills: Token counting, compaction strategies, context window management

features.name: Token Counter
features.description: Token counting utility (tiktoken-go or simple word-based estimator). Counts messages, tool results, system prompts.

features.name: ContextPolicy
features.description: Define ContextPolicy struct: MaxTokens, Sources (enum), Breadth (wide/narrow), Depth (shallow/deep). Agents are configured with a policy.

features.name: Three-Tier Compaction
features.description: Budget check (drop oldest tool results) → micro-compact (truncate long outputs) → full compaction (LLM-based summarization). Inspired by Claude Code.

features.name: System Prompt Engineering
features.description: Configurable system prompt builder: role definition + stage instructions + tool descriptions + context policy directives.

milestones.name: Pipeline Engine
milestones.goal: Multi-stage orchestration with verification gates and checkpoint

features.name: Stage Interface
features.description: Define Stage[In, Out] with Run() and Verify() (verification gate). Define Gate types: Auto, LLMReview, HumanApproval.

features.name: Pipeline FSM
features.description: Finite state machine: stage registration, conditional routing (next/retry/fail), maxRetries per stage. ~300 lines.

features.name: Checkpoint Store
features.description: SQLite-backed checkpoint: serialize PipelineState via gob, save/restore on stage transitions. Pipeline survives process restarts.

features.name: Interrupt / Resume
features.description: Human-in-the-loop: pipeline pauses at HumanApproval gates, persists state, resumes when approval arrives via API or CLI.

features.name: Audit Log
features.description: Event audit table in SQLite: every stage transition, gate result, error, and resume action is logged with timestamp.

milestones.name: Dev Workflow
milestones.goal: Complete development workflow: requirement → design → code → review → test
milestones.go_skills: Comprehensive application of all previous skills

features.name: Requirement Analysis Stage
features.description: Agent reads requirement description, analyzes scope, identifies affected components. Output: structured RequirementSpec.

features.name: Technical Design Stage
features.description: Agent generates technical design doc based on RequirementSpec. Output: TechDesign with approach, files to modify, risks.

features.name: Coding Stage
features.description: Agent implements code changes per TechDesign using file/shell tools. Narrow+deep ContextPolicy. Output: CodeChanges (file diffs).

features.name: Auto Review Stage
features.description: Evaluator-Optimizer pattern: review agent scores code quality, suggests improvements. If score < threshold, bounces back to Coding.

features.name: Testing Stage
features.description: Agent generates and runs tests. Validates build + lint + test pass. Output: TestReport.

features.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
features.description: Orchestrator-Worker pattern: orchestrator decomposes tasks, spawns worker agents in parallel goroutines, synthesizes results.

milestones.name: Production Ready
milestones.goal: HTTP API, CLI, observability, and documentation

features.name: HTTP API Server
features.description: REST API: POST /pipeline/trigger, GET /pipeline/{id}, POST /pipeline/{id}/resume, GET /health. net/http stdlib.

features.name: Webhook Handler
features.description: GitHub/GitLab webhook endpoint: receive MR comments, trigger pipeline resume or review.

features.name: CLI
features.description: Command-line interface: goforge chat (interactive), goforge run (trigger pipeline), goforge status. Single binary.

features.name: Observability
features.description: OpenTelemetry: trace spans per pipeline stage and agent step, metrics for token usage and latency. Zap structured logging throughout.

features.name: MCP Server
features.description: Expose GoForge itself as an MCP server: tools for triggering pipelines, querying status. Enables integration with Cursor/Claude.

features.name: README and Documentation
features.description: Complete README with architecture diagram, quickstart, API reference. Ensure all docs pass desensitization scan.
